details.resultBody: On Saturday, Zoë saw a 🌱 sign near the gate. Then Zoë and Sam arrived at the community garden to plant beans. They stopped beside a volunteer who offered to help them learn a simple planting method. After watching her demonstration, Sam placed the seeds in a wooden box while Zoë covered them with soil. The tap was nearby, so they did not have to carry water far. They would share the watering work over the coming weeks, with Zoë visiting on weekdays and Sam taking the weekend. Before leaving, they checked that the card beside the box showed both names. Neither knew when the first shoot would appear.
